cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You held up three fingers to the removal man; I've held up four. I'll help with your sofa for four hours painting my shed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was showing him the third floor. Not quoting a price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the floor rate. Three flights with a sofa, plus loading: four hours of painting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The lift works. You only need to help me get it through the doors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One hour, then. But you bring the paint; I'm not giving up another hour to go and buy it.

reason: Give A a mistaken copied signal and make the working lift reduce the actual priced burden.
